meta.title: nanoPost Email Check demo
meta.description: The plugin screen with sample results: a week of passes and a failed check with an SMTP error. All data is fake.
meta.author: nanoPost

steps.code:
<?php
// Demo state for the Live Preview. Fake data only. Same story as screenshots/scenes.php "failed".
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_user_meta( 1, 'show_welcome_panel', 0 );

$to = 'alerts@example.com';
remove_all_filters( 'sanitize_option_' . NanoPost_Email_Check_Settings::OPTION );
update_option( NanoPost_Email_Check_Settings::OPTION, array( 'recipient' => $to, 'interval' => 'daily', 'webhook_url' => '' ) );

$now  = time();
$day  = DAY_IN_SECONDS;
$hour = HOUR_IN_SECONDS;
$last = $now - 3 * $hour;
$err  = 'SMTP Error: Could not authenticate.';

// Oldest first: a week of passes, a failure, a failed manual retry, the fix, passes, then a new failure.
$rows = array();
for ( $d = 10; $d >= 4; $d-- ) {
	$rows[] = array( 'scheduled', true, '', $last - $d * $day );
}
$rows[] = array( 'scheduled', false, $err, $last - 3 * $day );
$rows[] = array( 'manual', false, $err, $last - 3 * $day + 2 * $hour + 42 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );
$rows[] = array( 'manual', true, '', $last - 3 * $day + 2 * $hour + 58 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );
for ( $d = 2; $d >= 0; $d-- ) {
	$rows[] = array( 'scheduled', true, '', $last - $d * $day );
}
$rows[] = array( 'scheduled', false, $err, $now - 20 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );

delete_option( NanoPost_Email_Check_Log::OPTION );
foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
	NanoPost_Email_Check_Log::add( new NanoPost_Email_Check_Result( 'wp_mail', $row[0], $row[1], $row[2], $to, $row[3] ) );
}

wp_clear_scheduled_hook( NanoPost_Email_Check_Scheduler::HOOK );
wp_schedule_event( $now - 20 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS + $day, 'daily', NanoPost_Email_Check_Scheduler::HOOK );
update_option(
	NanoPost_Email_Check_Scheduler::STATE_OPTION,
	array(
		'since'          => $last - 11 * $day,
		'last_completed' => $now - 20 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS,
	)
);
